rows.blocker_reason: A prospective public dataset and pre-registered case battery are not yet available inside the current release resources.
rows.description: Design a prospective test set for K-level transition hypotheses without using retrospective examples as proof.
rows.goal: Determine which K-level obligations survive independent future cases.
rows.hypothesis: If the K-level hierarchy captures real structural transitions, independently selected cases should preserve the predicted support/demotion pattern under predeclared criteria.
rows.method: Pre-register observable families, lock source snapshots, run finite/replay checks, compare residuals against negative controls, then classify support, demotion, or falsifier.
rows.possible_outcomes: Support would strengthen domain projection; mixed results would refine K-level criteria; failure would demote or restructure the affected K-level claims.
rows.title: Prospective K-Level Prediction Battery

rows.blocker_reason: The current certificate records binding failures and cannot be honestly promoted as clean support.
rows.description: Repair or rebuild the Lean/source-manifest binding so mechanized support can be promoted only when source hashes and theorem names match.
rows.goal: Separate formalization inventory from machine-checked theorem support without ambiguity.
rows.hypothesis: A clean certificate will either promote a smaller mechanized subset or expose exact theorem obligations that remain prose/finite only.
rows.method: Rebuild the Lean project from the pinned source tree, bind theorem names to proof sheets, record toolchain, source hashes, and failure rows.
rows.possible_outcomes: Clean build promotes selected machine-checked rows; mismatch keeps Lean as inventory and creates formal work orders.
rows.title: Clean Lean Certificate Binding

rows.blocker_reason: No independently locked prospective replay corpus is packaged in Core 1.3.3.
rows.description: Convert retrospective bounded replay QA into a prospective or externally held-out replay design.
rows.goal: Test whether replay/comparator rows predict unseen targets rather than reconstructing known rows.
rows.hypothesis: If OC projection constraints add value, locked formulas should outperform specified comparator baselines on held-out rows.
rows.method: Lock formulas, data snapshots, comparator baselines, negative controls, residual thresholds, and failure rules before evaluation.
rows.possible_outcomes: Positive results support domain projection; null or adverse results demote empirical language and refine formulas.
rows.title: Prospective Replay And Comparator Study

rows.blocker_reason: The current corpus does not yet contain complete proof/evidence lanes for every domain projection.
rows.description: Map where OC can speak as model grammar, where it has theorem support, and where it has empirical support.
rows.goal: Prevent architectural ambition from becoming unsupported all-domain assertion.
rows.hypothesis: The release is strongest as a claim-governed model core until enough proof and replay rows exist per domain.
rows.method: For each domain projection, require a source packet, theorem/proof or finite witness, comparator, replay/evidence row, falsifier, and explicit nonclaim.
rows.possible_outcomes: A complete row can be promoted narrowly; an incomplete row remains an example or future-research task.
rows.title: All-Domain Scope Boundary Audit
